title: feat(console): an app's docs pages draw in the app shell from 768 px up
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Part of #37150 — this PR carries Change items 1, 3 and 4 (an app's docs pages, `/apps/APP/docs…`, in the app shell from 768 px up; every old docs URL pinned; phone unchanged). Item 2 (the standalone `/docs` portal in the same appearance) is carried by #37197: the maintainer ruled B, an app-less shell variant (#37150 comment 7151721568), design first.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 电脑上从应用里打开文档（应用内的文档首页、书、文章）时，顶栏没有了，左侧是和其它应用页面一样的侧栏，侧栏正文换成文档目录；手机不变，独立的文档门户这次没改。
- 属于「去掉顶栏和平台首页那一层」专题的第三阶段：让读者在应用和它的手册之间来回时看到同一种外壳。
- 出错时读者在电脑上看文档会找不到目录或返回应用的入口；改动只在前端，直接撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 不需要你再定什么：独立文档门户的外壳已按你选的 B 方案定下（不属于任何应用的外壳变体，#37150 评论 7151721568），由 #37197 承接，先出设计图给你看，批准后再做。#37197 设计图里唯一会牵动本 PR 的问题是「全部文档」放在侧栏哪里（本 PR 目前放在底部）。

## What changes

- `ConsoleLayout` (app shell): the `isAppDocsPath` exception now holds on a phone only. From 768 px up an app's docs pages mount `UnifiedSidebar` (head: app-name menu, collapse, search, bell; foot: account) and draw no top bar, like every other desktop app page. The connection banner shows there too, since no bar carries it any more.
- `UnifiedSidebar` takes `docsNav`: on an app's docs route its body is an empty target (`SidebarDocsNavTarget`) in place of the app's menu and recents (the one-navigation rule of the earlier docs work holds: a reader has one navigation, the docs').
- New `layout/sidebarDocsNavSlot.tsx`: a provider (mounted by `ConsoleLayout`), the sidebar's target element, and `SidebarDocsNav`, a portal the docs page draws its column through, so the column keeps the page's router and data context. Exported from `@object-ui/app-shell` with the two existing page-header slot hooks.
- Console docs pages: `DocShell` draws the column into the sidebar when the slot exists (the reader's own column, else `AppDocsNav`: every book of the app, 「← Back to APP」 and 「All documentation」) and draws the page header's button group and expand button at the page's top. `DocPage` stops drawing its in-page column when the sidebar carries it. `usePackageDocsNavBooks` is the reader's former inline memo, lifted so the non-reader pages share it.
- `ConsoleBootShell`: the boot fallback matches (sidebar, no bar on an app's docs page from 768 px up; unchanged on a phone).
- Unchanged: every route and URL shape (ADR-0046 section 6), the `/docs` portal frame (`DocsPortalRoute`, `DefaultHomeLayout variant="docs"`), the phone.

## Tests

- `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483.test.tsx`: the route exception's removal: at 768 and 1440 px, `/apps/crm/docs`, `/apps/crm/docs/`, a book, a flat permalink and an article mount the sidebar with `docsNav` and no top bar; PHONE CONTROL at 390 px keeps no sidebar and the app bar; control: other app routes keep the app menu.
- `UnifiedSidebar.footerSlot-36739.test.tsx`: the page's column lands in the sidebar body, the app menu is gone, head and foot stay; control without `docsNav`.
- `ConsoleBootShell-35981.test.tsx`: the boot fallback at 768/1440 vs 375 px.
- `docs-portal.test.tsx` (objectstack#37150 block): the reader's one column is in the sidebar; the page header carries the shell's group; old URL forms in the shell: reader, book, flat permalink, docs index, book NAME, book NAME/DOC, doc-name-that-is-also-a-book-name, canonical SLUG/DOC each land on the same canonical URL and article as before; non-reader pages; CONTROL without the shell (phone, `/docs`): the page draws its own column and back link. The `/docs` URL forms keep their existing pins in the same file (unchanged frame).

<details><summary>Test runs (head fd2011e51)</summary>

All through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `--maxWorkers=2`, at fd2011e51 unless noted.

- The four pinned files (`ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483`, `ConsoleLayout.noTopBar-36112`, `UnifiedSidebar.footerSlot-36739`, `ConsoleBootShell-35981`): `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 23 passed` for the two ConsoleLayout files at fd2011e51; the sidebar and boot files `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 27 passed (27)` at 827b3c75a (unchanged since).
- `docs-portal.test.tsx`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 62 passed (62)` at 827b3c75a; the objectstack#37150 block with the added URL pins `Tests 13 passed | 53 skipped (66)` at 2ec431259.
- Narrowed suite: every app-shell test that names `ConsoleLayout`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `ConsoleBootShell`, `consoleRoutePaths`, `sidebarDocsNavSlot` or `isAppDocsPath` (128 files) and every console test that names a docs page (13 files), at 2ec431259: app-shell `Test Files 1 failed | 127 passed (128)`, the one red was `ConsoleLayout.noTopBar-36112`'s control pinning the old docs-page bar, corrected in fd2011e51 and green above; console `Test Files 13 passed (13)`, `Tests 122 passed (122)`.
- `type-check` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`) after rebuilding the app-shell dependency closure: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Full app-shell and console suites: declared to CI (`Test UI`); the local full run was stopped after 38 minutes holding the shared lock.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, restored byte-identical to HEAD)</summary>

Both through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 -> 0 on disk, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import these sources directly (relative import; `@object-ui/app-shell` aliased to `src` in the console's vite config), so no `dist/` is involved.

1. `ConsoleLayout.tsx`: `phoneDocsPage ? undefined : (` -> `docsPage ? undefined : (` (the sidebar exception back at every width). Expected red; observed: `× at 768 px and 1440 px a docs index, a book, a flat permalink and an article draw the sidebar …`, `Tests 1 failed | 14 passed (15)`; the PHONE CONTROL stayed green.
2. `DocPage.tsx`: `const pageNav = sidebarNav ? null : docsNav;` -> `const pageNav = docsNav;` (the reader draws its in-page column in the shell too). Expected red; observed `Tests 9 failed | 4 passed | 53 skipped (66)`: the one-column test and all eight URL-form pins (two columns).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 2 is not in this PR; it is carried by #37197.** `ConsoleLayout` is app-scoped by construction and `/docs` names no app. The maintainer ruled option B, an app-less shell variant (「B：做一个不属于任何应用的外壳变体（推荐）」, #37150 comment 7151721568), and asked to see the design first. #37197 carries it: stage 1 mockups, then the build after approval and after this PR lands.
- With the sidebar collapsed, the docs page's header row draws the shell's expand button; it registers with the shell's header registry, so the content-corner fallback does not draw a second one.
- Screenshots were taken at the implementation commits (096ac6732), before the `origin/main` merge; the merge's only overlap with this surface is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, merged clean, and no implementation file changed after.

## Verification

Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx`: the `phoneDocsPage` hunk (sidebar mount and `showHeader`), the branch the shell's look hangs on.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocShell.tsx`: the sidebar portal and the page-header row.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the `docsNav` body swap.

Two-minute check: in the showcase app (`pnpm dev`), open the Showcase app's documentation from its menu at 1440 px: no top bar, the sidebar head reads 「Showcase」, the sidebar body is the docs column with 「← Back to Showcase」 first and 「All documentation」 last; narrow the window to 390 px and the app bar and the in-page column are back.
